product.title: San Diego Private Sailing Charter (3-Hour Classic Yacht Experience)

description.text: Board a classic French yacht for a small-group sailing experience on San Diego Bay with skyline views, harbor landmarks, and relaxed onboard hospitality. The route highlights well-known waterfront points such as Coronado Bridge, Seaport Village, and Point Loma while your captain handles navigation. This experience is designed for travelers who want scenic sailing time, local photo opportunities, and a flexible on-the-water pace.

highlights: Sail San Diego Bay aboard a classic French yacht.
Views of Coronado Bridge, Seaport Village, Point Loma, and waterfront landmarks.
Small-group format with mobile ticket and English-language hosting.
Beer and wine included, with coffee, tea, and sparkling water provided.

start.description: H&M Landing, 2803 Emerson St, San Diego, CA 92106, USA. On your charter day, meet your captain at H&M Landing and call your captain once you arrive.

itineraryItems.title: Coronado Bridge
itineraryItems.description: Cruise beneath Coronado Bridge and take in wide skyline views of downtown San Diego from the water.

itineraryItems.title: Coronado Island
itineraryItems.description: Sail along Coronado Island for classic harbor panoramas and a relaxed view of the shoreline.

itineraryItems.title: Seaport Village
itineraryItems.description: Pass Seaport Village and enjoy views of the waterfront shops, marina traffic, and bayside boardwalk activity.

itineraryItems.title: Point Loma
itineraryItems.description: Glide past Point Loma where the bay entrance opens to coastal scenery and dramatic cliffs.

itineraryItems.title: Sunset Cliffs Natural Park
itineraryItems.description: Take in the rugged coastline near Sunset Cliffs, with sea cave formations and Pacific swells shaping the bluffs.

itineraryItems.title: Chicano Park
itineraryItems.description: See the Chicano Park area from the water as your route traces iconic bridge spans and urban shoreline views.

itineraryItems.title: Shelter Island
itineraryItems.description: Sail by Shelter Island to spot marina rows, sailboats, and harborfront neighborhoods.

itineraryItems.title: Waterfront Park Downtown San Diego
itineraryItems.description: Finish near Waterfront Park with open views toward downtown towers, piers, and active waterfront promenades.

additionalInfo: Guests can bring their own meals and snacks, but they are not complimentary to the service.
Confirmation will be received at time of booking.
This tour/activity will have a maximum of 6 travelers.
Free cancellation up to 24 hours before the experience starts (local time).

faqs.question: Where is the meeting point for this sail?
faqs.answer: Meet at H&M Landing, 2803 Emerson St, San Diego, CA 92106, and contact your captain on arrival.

faqs.question: How long is the sailing experience?
faqs.answer: The listed duration is approximately 2 hours and 30 minutes.

faqs.question: What is included onboard?
faqs.answer: Inclusions list a Polaroid camera and film, coffee and tea, sparkling water, and alcoholic beverages.

faqs.question: Can travelers cancel for a full refund?
faqs.answer: Yes. Free cancellation is available up to 24 hours before the experience start time.

faqs.question: How many travelers can join?
faqs.answer: The experience lists a maximum of 6 travelers.
